summary: Full frontend verification of refonte Carte (Galista Café). Validated structure, scroll-spy, tab jumps, mobile recentering, i18n (fr/de/en), Glaces specifics, allergen banner, no glossary, no regressions. All 7 criteria PASS on desktop 1440 and mobile 375.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: #contact id not found — site uses a different id (e.g., 'infos'/'nous-trouver') for contact section. Not in review scope but worth confirming anchors used by header links.
Console warning observed: 'ensure that the container has a non-static position' (likely Lenis/ScrollTrigger setup) — informational, not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loader bypass: sessionStorage.setItem('galista-loader-seen','1'). Lenis anime ~1.2s donc attendre 2.2s après clic. Tab clicks sur onglets sticky peuvent échouer avec Playwright .click() si viewport trop petit — utiliser evaluate("el.click()") pour contourner. Sections ancrées: #menu-{categoryId}; onglets: [data-testid=category-filter-{id}]. Active class contains 'active' (pill--active).
